desc: Construct both outgoing and incoming adjacency lists for the directed graph.
Define the two-layer state transitions: movement within each parity layer and parity toggling at cost `X`.
Implement Dijkstra’s algorithm over `2N` states with a min-heap and stale-distance checks.
Output the minimum distance to vertex `N`, using Python integers.
Ensure the implementation uses efficient `O((N+M) log N)` time and avoids explicitly duplicating all reversed edges.
